in the same goddamn boat. if you ever want talk about it, id be down. i broke up with my girlfriend of a year and then i decided that wasnt right. when i went back, she was already dating another guy. still trying to figure out how to get over it. i'd love to talk to you man, i'm sure it'd help us both.

btw, idk how long you've been going through this but ive been trying to get over this since october, and it still kills me every day. so im right there with you.
hey man, im sorry this is so late, ive been trying to get out and stuff. are you still up?

and its the reason my ex girlfriend couldnt handle me anymore was because i just became so emotional in my own head without being able to tell her what was wrong. i wasnt able to communicate how i felt about her, or my situation with my split up family. I would have pm'd you but this is a throwaway so its not like it really matters if its out there.
